description: Test class for the Security utility class in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for methods like encodeString, hashMatches, encrypt, and decrypt.

classes.name: SecurityTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Security utility class, testing encoding, hashing, encryption, and decryption functionalities.

methods.name: encodeString_shouldEncodeStringsTo128Characters
methods.description: Tests that the encodeString method produces a hash of length 128 for the input string.

methods.name: encodeString_shouldEncodeStringsToXCharactersWithXCharactersSalt
methods.description: Tests that encoding a string with a salt still results in a 128-character hash.

methods.name: hashMatches_shouldMatchStringsHashedWithSha1Algorithm
methods.description: Checks that hash comparison correctly identifies matching SHA1 hashes.

methods.name: hashMatches_shouldMatchStringsHashedWithSha512AlgorithmAnd128CharactersSalt
methods.description: Verifies that the hashMatches method confirms a match for a SHA512 hashed password with salt.

methods.name: hashMatches_shouldMatchStringsHashedWithIncorrectSha1Algorithm
methods.description: Ensures that the hashMatches method still considers slightly altered hashes as matching (possibly testing resilience).

methods.name: decrypt_shouldDecryptShortAndLongText
methods.description: Tests that the Security.decrypt method correctly decrypts both short and long encrypted text samples.

methods.name: encrypt_shouldEncryptShortAndLongText
methods.description: Tests that encryption followed by decryption restores the original string for various lengths and content types, including foreign characters.
